nodes.title: SG-5.4.2 BootScene preloads only planned assets with fallback texture
nodes.body:
Context: planPreload and resolveTextureKey exist in game/src/engine/planPreload.ts but BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) has no preload and effectContext.ts passes spec.asset straight to Phaser. Desired behavior: BootScene loads only the planned assets, resolves every texture key through resolveTextureKey and uses a fallback texture for missing or invalid assets. Why: avoid loading unused assets and avoid crashes or green-box textures.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the bedroom scene, when BootScene.preload runs, then only ids in planPreload(scene, manifest).load are queued with the loader
- Given an id not in the manifest or a file that fails to load, when a texture key is resolved, then the fallback texture key is returned and used
- Given the dust effect asset, when the effect is created, then its texture key comes from resolveTextureKey


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.preload
- In scope: bundled manifest in runtime/content.ts
- In scope: effectContext key resolution
- In scope: runtime fallback texture
- Out of scope: new pixel-art files
- Out of scope: changing planPreload or resolveTextureKey
- Out of scope: backend
- Preserve: existing BootScene create/shutdown behavior
- Preserve: engine planPreload API


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- Engine code in game/src must not import Phaser


## Definition of done
- Both requirements verified by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene preloads only the planned assets
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene has no preload method and the frontend has no manifest. Desired: runtime/content.ts exposes the validated manifest and BootScene.preload loads only planned ids using manifest paths under assets/. Expected: unlisted manifest assets are never requested. Why: avoid unnecessary loading.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given scene objects and dust effect referencing known ids, when preload runs, then load.image is called once per planned id with the key equal to the id and url assets/<manifest path>
- Given a manifest asset not referenced by the scene, when preload runs, then no load call is made for it
- Given unknown refs in the plan, when preload runs, then a console.warn names each and nothing is queued for them


## Scope
- In scope: runtime/content.ts manifest export
- In scope: BootScene.preload
- Out of scope: audio loading
- Preserve: scene export


## Technical constraints
- Use parseManifest from @game/assets/manifest and planPreload from @game/engine/planPreload


## Definition of done
- preload queues only planned assets


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Texture keys resolve through resolveTextureKey with a fallback texture
nodes.body:
Context: effectContext passes spec.asset directly to Phaser particles. Desired: BootScene generates a fallback texture keyed by FALLBACK_ASSET_ID, records ids whose load fails, and resolves every key via resolveTextureKey. Why: missing assets must not crash or show Phaser's missing texture.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an id absent from the manifest, when resolved, then the fallback key is returned
- Given a loaderror for an id, when resolved, then the fallback key is returned
- Given a dust effect with a missing asset, when created, then particles use the fallback key


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene fallback generation and loaderror handling
- In scope: effectContext resolver parameter
- Out of scope: authored fallback art file
- Preserve: effect behavior for known assets


## Technical constraints
- FALLBACK_ASSET_ID from @game/assets/loaders/manifestLoader must not pull in node fs at runtime: define key via a literal 'fallback:missing' in BootScene


## Definition of done
- all texture keys resolved


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.description: Add resolver param to createPhaserEffectContext, generate the fallback texture in preload, track failed ids.
definition_of_done: resolver used for every texture key

steps.action: Add second parameter `resolveKey: (id: string) => string` and replace `spec.asset` in scene.add.particles with `resolveKey(spec.asset)`.

In preload, call this.textures.generate? no: use make.graphics to draw a 8x8 magenta/black checker and generateTexture('fallback:missing',8,8); register this.load.on('loaderror', f => this.failed.add(f.key)). Add private failed=new Set<string>() and resolveKey(id)=> this.failed.has(id) ? 'fallback:missing' : resolveTextureKey(id, manifest, 'fallback:missing'). In create pass (id)=>this.resolveKey(id) to createPhaserEffectContext.
steps.code: const g = this.make.graphics({ x: 0, y: 0 }, false); g.fillStyle(0xff00ff).fillRect(0,0,8,8).fillStyle(0x000000).fillRect(0,0,4,4).fillRect(4,4,4,4); g.generateTexture('fallback:missing', 8, 8); g.destroy();
steps.expected: Fallback texture exists and resolveKey returns it for unknown or failed ids
